tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram v0.105.0 to v0.106.0 with the exact published command contract: `reactions list <chat> <message> [query]` (newest first, `reaction:<emoji>`, --limit and --cursor, read only, permission `reactions.list`, refused with `reactions.broadcast` in a channel and `reactions.list-hidden` where the chat hides the list); `contacts info` is now `contacts show`, which also answers --offline and takes --with-notes; phone numbers are shown whole and `--show-phone` is gone, `--hide-phone` leaves the number out of `account show`, `account update` and `contacts show`; a shared contact card shows its name and phone; `contacts sync` saves phones; inbox, review and search answers carry `sender_is_me`; the agent skill is listed on ClawHub as `wirecat-tg`; the `mcp serve --profiles` examples no longer name a profile. RU/ES changelog, commands, people and usage reviewed, and cli-contract's architecture link moved to the v0.106.0 tag. The roadmap is unchanged since v0.92.0 and none of its planned items (chat notes, emoji reaction rankings, remaining max parity, location messages) shipped: `reactions list` names who reacted, it does not add per emoji counts to rankings.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX v0.85.0 to v0.86.0 with the exact published command contract (Core 0.478.0): `max mcp serve` with no profile refuses (exit 2) and lists the profiles; `--profiles a,b` or `--profiles all` serves several from one server, also for `--http`, `mcp server start|stop|status`, `mcp revoke` and `mcp config`; `contacts show` replaces `contacts info`, phone numbers print whole and `--hide-phone` leaves them out (`account show`, `account update`, `contacts show`); `sender_is_me` on messages, inbox, review and search hits; the agent skill is `wirecat-max` on ClawHub. RU commands and EN/ES changed guides, changelog and technical reference reviewed. The roadmap is unchanged since v0.76.0; none of its planned items shipped in these releases.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed released Zoom 0.48.0 (Core 0.430.0/Base 0.57.0, unchanged from 0.47.0). A bare zm --version answers before the program loads; no command, option or output changed. Native configuration, installation and troubleshooting guides now give recorded runs under ~/.local/share/zoom-cli/runs and files.problems entries as path, mode and want; RU/ES translated. Roadmap unchanged from 0.47.0. Earlier: Reviewed released Zoom 0.43.0–0.47.0 (Core 0.430.0/Base 0.57.0) against the npm package in an isolated home. config.json is saved owner-only (0600); doctor --json reports config.issues, each with a fix that runs as written, and files.problems for a config file or folder other users can read; doctor answers when the config path is a folder. New config unset, runs list|show|path, skill status, skill show --for and store info. Old setting names (account_profile, camelCase keys, zoom.clientId) and permission keys that name no command are refused; zm serve is gone. Anyone last signed in with zm 0.34 or earlier must run zm <profile> session start again; portal errata state this on the installation update step and the sessions login step, and drop the old document-source provider value folder from configuration. The 0.42 security/search/usage/roadmap errata and the mcp upgrade-note erratum are retired because 0.47.0 ships those fixes. EN/RU/ES archive, configuration, mcp, search, security, sessions, troubleshooting, usage, commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap: review, mentions, saved searches, query fields, copyable examples and MCP discovery are available; attended-call audio recording, meeting notes, speaker naming, other hosts' meetings, a reviewed preparation brief, macOS/Windows backups and other platforms remain later. Earlier: Reviewed Zoom0.36.0–0.42.0 with the exact published command contract, including permission discovery, unified search hit paging, review/mentions/saved searches, model and archive vocabulary, profile examples and keyring diagnostics. EN/RU/ES full guide and technical-reference review completed. Source Zoom#245 corrects older released security/search/usage/roadmap claims; explicit portal runtime errata preserve the reviewed0.42 grammar and discovery contract3 rather than importing newer Core411 behavior. Custom/team-authorized Zoomapp required; no public shared app promised. Audio recording of attended calls, notes/speaker naming, broader preparation and additional platforms remain planned.

drive.conclusion: Reviewed released Drive 0.45.1 (Core 0.473.0/Base 0.65.0), covering 0.41.1 (Core 0.448.0/Base 0.59.0), 0.42.0 (Core 0.450.0/Base 0.63.0), 0.43.0 (Core 0.451.0/Base 0.63.0), 0.44.0 (Core 0.467.0/Base 0.64.0) and 0.45.0 (Core 0.469.0/Base 0.65.0). 0.44.0 makes mcp a help-only group: the server is mcp serve (stdio or --http, --tools lists commands), mcp revoke replaces mcp --revoke, the shared store moves to schema 35, every run is kept (successes 7 days, keep_successful_runs_for_days, runs_size_limit_mb, record_input failed) and skill --json answers { item, meta }. 0.45.0 requires a named profile or --profiles a,b / --profiles all for mcp serve, mcp revoke and mcp server start|stop|status, and runs from a bundle. 0.45.1 keeps --profiles in the follow-up commands it prints. 0.42.0/0.43.0 add path-prefixed public URLs, a WireCat Desktop sign-in hint and faster meaning search. EN/RU/ES commands, configuration (run retention rows), recipes, remote (mcp serve, --profiles, mcp revoke), scenarios and changelog reviewed; other guides unchanged. Roadmap unchanged since 0.38.0: Google app review in progress, background mirrors watch service next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: Reviewed released Drive 0.41.0 (Core 0.446.0/Base 0.59.0), covering 0.39.0 (Core 0.435.0/Base 0.57.1) and 0.40.0 (Core 0.437.0/Base 0.59.0). 0.39.0 moves the shared store to version 34 (search-by-meaning index), so older WireCat CLIs refuse it, and drive upgrade shows only --check as its example. 0.40.0 adds skill install --for hermes, names OpenClaw or Hermes runs, declares metadata.openclaw in the skill, and drive runs --help shows no profile. 0.41.0 adds mcp server start|stop|status for the background HTTP MCP server, gives the Google sign-in page as an open_url line, keeps the command as typed in a run record with secrets hidden (record_input false hides every value that may be content). EN/RU/ES commands, configuration (record_input, --record), installation, remote (background server) and changelog reviewed; other guides unchanged. Roadmap unchanged since 0.38.0: Google app review in progress, background watch service next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: Reviewed released Drive 0.38.0 (Core 0.432.0/Base 0.57.1), covering 0.37.0. 0.37.0 adds drive store info: it describes the shared store (path, schema against the one drive reads with schema.reason and schema.upgrade, which tools used it), opens it read-only and needs no profile; the store group help covers the shared store. Run recording comes from cli-core recordRuns with the same runs kept; a run with no profile leaves profile out instead of an empty string. 0.38.0 answers a bare drive --version before the program loads. Native drive-cli#238 drops the release number from the configuration page and moves front matter in mirrored Markdown from Next into the current summary, so both portal corrections from the 0.36.0 review are retired. EN/RU/ES commands (store info), configuration (an older drive), roadmap (front matter in the current summary) and changelog reviewed; other guides unchanged. Roadmap: Google app review in progress, background watch service next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: Drive 0.36.0 (Core 0.428.0/Base 0.57.0), covering 0.35.0. Since 0.35.0 drive reads setting names only as written: old setting names are refused as unknown settings like any other key, every command except config and doctor refuses a file with a problem and names its drive config unset fix, and doctor --json lists every problem under config.issues (kind, file, profile, key, what, fix). New config unset removes one setting from a profile, the defaults or the top of the file; config show/set/unset keep working on a file with problems. 0.36.0 saves config.json as 0600; doctor reports a config file or folder others can read under files.problems and prints the chmod; the refusal's (and N more problems) counts what doctor lists; skill status and skill show --for come from cli-base; housekeeping commands (doctor, config show, session list, runs, models, api list) show no profile in help. EN/RU/ES configuration (old-name paragraphs and the saved-default sentence removed; new Fix a problem in the file and Keep the file private sections), troubleshooting (doctor row, Name a profile), scenarios (every account command names personal; the portal profile correction retired because 0.35.0 ships it), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap: front matter in mirrored Markdown shipped (drive-cli#228, cli-core#1952) and is removed from Next by a portal correction until the native roadmap drops it; Google app review in progress, background watch service next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: Drive 0.34.0 (Core 0.422.0/Base 0.53.0). drive keeps a log of its runs like tg, max and wa: failed runs always, every run with --record or record: true in defaults, for keep_runs_for_days (30); runs list|show|path read them without a profile, and a run never holds a document id, name or text. Help and MCP examples speak of drive and name a profile. EN/RU/ES configuration (record, keep_runs_for_days, --record/--no-record), troubleshooting (failed-run symptom row), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap unchanged: Google app review in progress, background watch service and front matter next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier: search --json hits carry cli-core's url and kind: "document", the same fields as memo search notes and search all; source_url is removed without an alias from hits and pictures, and a folder hit is told apart by not_read: "folder metadata only". An expired Google sign-in now tells an agent that signing in is the owner's step. EN/RU/ES search and usage now name url; the recipes and troubleshooting guide overrides (documents account, older-CLI refusal) are retired because 0.33.0 ships those pages. Roadmap unchanged from 0.32.0: Google app review in progress, background watch service and front matter next, larger annotation copies and mirror deletion later. Earlier review of 0.30.0 to 0.32.0: 0.32.0 keeps Drive documents in the store's own Google Drive account named by the drive profile; Core 0.420.0 moves them on first open (store versions 30 to 33), keeps every document:<id> reference, and older CLIs refuse the store until upgraded; two processes on one profile share a single Google sign-in refresh. 0.31.0 moves files list to the shared field query language (name:, modified_time with offsets, --timezone; raw Google queries stay under api), adds schema-derived list queries and joins a file's owner or editor with the mail contact of the same exact email. 0.30.0 removes mirrors sync/watch --public-url: Google Docs inserts only publicly downloadable images, so local images stay as Markdown text. EN/RU/ES mirrors (new section on when a Markdown file in Drive is enough; local images section rewritten), recipes (search only Drive documents from Memo with --source drive:<profile>), roadmap (tunnel image claim removed from the current summary), commands and changelog reviewed. Roadmap: background watch service and front matter stay next; larger annotation copies and mirror deletion stay later; Google app review stays in progress. The documents account and the older-CLI refusal reach the recipes and troubleshooting guides through docs-only guide overrides (drive PRs 220 and 222). No live Google request or global upgrade.

EN/RU/ES configuration and the 0.108.0 release notes reviewed. Roadmap unchanged: nothing under Next or Later shipped. Earlier: Reviewed Memo 0.98.0–0.107.0 with exact Core 0.431.0/Base 0.57.0. 0.107.0 adds doctor file-permission checks (files.problems with the chmod fix on stderr) and owner-only config.json saves; 0.104.0 adds config.issues with a runnable fix, memo config unset, run logs (runs list/show/path, record, keep_runs_for_days), renames config.exists to config.found, refuses retired permission keys and removes sync --account and the ignored --brief/--full of search all/notes; 0.103.0 moves notes folders to obsidian/local accounts on the shared store; 0.100.0/0.101.0 add people and confirmed-member lanes to projects evidence; 0.105.0 adds store info, skill status/show --for and run errors; 0.106.0 moves run recording to Core. The released changelog has no 0.102.0 section, and configuration.md still says Memo has no config command (portal correction; cli-memo source issues). wa.conclusion: Reviewed WhatsApp v0.11.0 to v0.17.0 with the published changelog and command contract: `reactions list <chat> <message>` (newest first, `reaction:<emoji>`, --limit and --cursor) lists who reacted from what the local store received (history push, serve and watch), because WhatsApp has no request for older reactions; a reaction sent with `reactions add` or one that arrived while nothing listened is missing, and a channel refuses it with `reactions.broadcast`. `contacts info` is now `contacts show` (--offline), `--show-phone` is gone and `--hide-phone` is the opt-in; a shared contact card shows name and phone. RU/ES changelog, commands, cli-contract, archive, bot, configuration-reference, diagnostics, limits, mcp, people, query-language, recipes, remote, sessions and usage reviewed. The roadmap plans are unchanged: reactions you send are still not kept in the local store, so that item stays planned, as do channel files, business labels, the guide command, more files per message and communities.

gcal.conclusion: Reviewed released Google Calendar 0.4.0 (Core 0.491.0/Base 0.65.5). 0.4.0 moves the shared store to version 40 (the trigram index notes and documents search uses), so an older gcal no longer leaves a newer tool's store without its index entries; no command, setting or guide changes. EN/RU/ES changelog reviewed, and the comparison re-dated to 0.4.0 with every competitor mark linked to its source. Roadmap unchanged since 0.3.0: sign-in through WireCat's shared Google app is still planned. Earlier: Reviewed released Google Calendar 0.3.0 (Core 0.489.0/Base 0.65.5), covering 0.2.0. 0.2.0 only publishes the skill on ClawHub as wirecat-gcal. 0.3.0 adds events move --to-calendar, events update|delete --following, events list changed:<date> and events list overlapping, and models list|download; create/update/move/respond are now allowed by default while delete asks, a series update that ends a series sooner needs events.delete.series, a failed sync prints nothing and fails with sync.partial carrying details.calendars, search and links review answer items, search --backend server refuses --newest, and a moved-folder run signs in to its own keyring entry. EN/RU/ES overview, usage, commands, settings, security, changelog, roadmap and the comparison reviewed. Roadmap matches the release: moving an event to another calendar and changing this-and-following occurrences shipped and left Next; sign-in through WireCat's shared Google app is still planned.
